title: Ministry updates info about missing Latvians in Nepal
summary_full: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs said on August 31st it is currently finalizing the technical procedure to send a Consular Department employee to Kathmandu, Nepal in the near future, in the wake of the recent disaster in Nepal and Tibet.
